metadata.name: Base Skill
metadata.description: Base skill with common conventions and tool preferences for all engineering skills
metadata.author: Infinity Team

instructions:
Base engineering principles that apply to all skills:

1. **Code Quality**:
   - TypeScript strict mode
   - ESLint + Prettier configured
   - No any types without justification
   - Comprehensive error handling

2. **Git Practices**:
   - Conventional commits (feat:, fix:, refactor:, etc.)
   - Atomic commits
   - Meaningful commit messages
   - Branch naming: type/description

3. **Testing**:
   - Unit tests for business logic
   - Integration tests for APIs
   - E2E tests for critical flows
   - Test coverage ≥80% for new code

4. **Documentation**:
   - JSDoc for public APIs
   - README for each package/module
   - Architecture decision records (ADRs)
   - Update docs with code changes

5. **Security Baseline**:
   - No secrets in code
   - Input validation
   - Dependency scanning
   - Principle of least privilege

6. **Observability**:
   - Structured logging
   - Error tracking
   - Performance monitoring
   - Health endpoints

conventions.name: no-any
conventions.description: Avoid any types - use unknown or proper types

conventions.name: error-handling
conventions.description: All async operations have error handling
